modules.title: 一次旅行预订怎样从浏览器走到确认页
端到端测试提供的核心质量凭证

items.title: 从用户入口开始，而不是从内部函数开始
items.text: 测试点击、输入、跳转和最终页面，使真实用户会经过的关键路径有一份可重复证据。它适合注册、支付前确认或创建内容等跨多层任务。

items.title: 关键路径要少而有代表性
items.text: 完整流程通常较慢、受环境影响更多，因此先覆盖最重要的成功和高风险失败路径。更细的规则仍应交给单元和集成测试更快地定位。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 端到端测试不等于“所有测试都在浏览器里点一遍”。它验证少量关键用户旅程；只有 API 或单个组件的检查能更快定位问题，但不能替代完整流程证据。

lessonPractice.title: 下面哪项最能证明“用户可以完成预订”这条端到端路径？

options.label: 在浏览器填写行程、提交、重新打开确认页，并核对显示的是刚才保存的行程
options.feedback: 对。它从用户操作入口走到最终可见结果，跨过必要系统。

options.label: 通过 API 创建行程，再检查数据库里是否写入了对应记录
options.feedback: 这能验证服务和数据的连接，但没有从用户操作入口经过页面和确认结果。

options.label: 在浏览器填写并提交行程，只检查页面有没有跳到确认页
options.feedback: 跳转本身不证明行程已经保存，也不证明确认页显示的是刚才提交的数据。

en.title: Which best proves the end-to-end path “a user can complete a booking”?

options.label: In a browser, enter an itinerary, submit it, reopen the confirmation page, and verify it shows the saved itinerary
options.feedback: Correct. It goes from the user's entry action to the final visible result across needed systems.

options.label: Create the itinerary through the API, then check whether the matching record exists in the database
options.feedback: That verifies the service and data connection, but it does not start from the user's page actions or check the visible confirmation.

options.label: Fill and submit the itinerary in a browser, but only check whether the page navigates to confirmation
options.feedback: Navigation alone does not prove the itinerary was saved or that confirmation shows the submitted data.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请补一条旅行预订 E2E 测试：从浏览器填写行程并保存，重新打开确认页后核对刚才的行程仍在。测试通过后告诉我实际走过的页面和最终看到的结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add an E2E test for a trip booking: fill and save an itinerary in a browser, then reopen the confirmation page and verify that itinerary remains. After it passes, tell me which pages it visited and the final result it saw.

learning.assumes: You can complete a registration, purchase, or save by following page steps.
learning.outcome: You can use one complete user task to judge whether a critical path really works from entry action to final visible result.

modules.title: How one trip booking goes from browser to confirmation

items.title: Start at the user entry point
items.text: The test clicks, types, navigates, and reaches a final page, giving repeatable evidence for the real critical path. It fits registration, pre-payment confirmation, and content creation.

items.title: Keep journeys few and representative
items.text: Full journeys are slower and depend more on environments, so cover essential success and high-risk failure paths first. Unit and integration tests still locate detailed rules faster.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: End-to-end testing is not clicking every test in a browser. It verifies a few critical user journeys; API and component checks can locate failures faster but cannot replace complete-flow evidence.

distinctions.label: Integration test
distinctions.text: An {c:e2e-test} follows a complete user journey. An {c:integration-test} can check only one connection, such as page to API or API to database.
